note: Family campground at 2498 E Hubert Rd, Spruce, off US-23 about 15 minutes from Alpena: grassy RV and tent sites, a rental cabin, game room, dog park and pavilion; the pool is closed for the 2026 season. New owners since 2025. Weekly, monthly and season rates are offered too. Near Lake Huron's BeeBee Beach and across the road from Thunder Bay River State Forest. --Claude
summary: Operator's site (new owners since 2025) confirms 2026 rates E&W $40 / FHU $45 (Campspot's electric-only $35 kept as the base), season May 1-Oct 15, sites to 43 ft, showers, store, $10 dump station, Campspot booking. Phone 314-719-9691 IS the operator's published number (tel: link on paulbunyancamp.com; the owners came from full-time van travel). Added season dates, max rig 43 ft, showers/dump; note: pool closed for 2026, hookup text dropped. Long-stay check: weekly/monthly/season rates offered, but Campspot sells 22 RV sites by the night; no seasonal count published, so not mostly seasonal on the evidence. No gateway within 40 km (Mackinac 144 km); $35-45 is under the gate. The operator calls it 'Paul Bunyan Campground' (Campspot: 'Paul Bunyan Family Campground').
